Reading this map: colour encodes dwellings completed per 1,000 residents in each district for the selected year, on one fixed scale shared across both cities and all years (0 to the 98th percentile of all district-year values; higher values are clipped to the top of the scale so a few outlier districts/years don't wash out the rest). Hover any district for the district name, year, raw number of dwellings completed, population, and the per-1,000 rate. The text above each map shows that city's total for the selected year.

Caveat: Berlin's figures are completions (Fertigstellungen) from Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg's F2 series. Copenhagen's KKBOL1 series is dwelling stock grouped by commissioning year, which is a proxy for completions rather than an identical measure, and may be revised in later releases. 2025 is provisional for both cities. See README.md in this folder for data sources, processing notes and licences, and the repository's outputs/REPORT.md for the full completions-vs-population analysis.
